# Foundations

The token layer at a glance, rendered from the source on every build. Every value here is the resolved value of a token in `src/`; the names are the CSS custom properties the components use. Read `COMPOSITION.md` for how the layout tokens sit together on a screen and `CATALOG.md` for which component to reach for.

## Layout

Each token names a structural decision, not a size. A page inset is not a control gap even when the numbers coincide; an agent picks the name for the job, never a rung off the primitive scale.

| Token | Value | Names |
|---|---|---|
| `layout.page.inset` | 32px | Distance from the viewport edge to page content. Never zero: content touching the edge is a boundary failure. |
| `layout.page.gap` | 48px | Vertical distance between top-level page sections. |
| `layout.page.max` | 64rem | The widest a page's content column may grow. |
| `layout.section.inset` | 24px | Padding inside a section that sits on its own surface. |
| `layout.section.gap` | 24px | Distance between groups within one section. |
| `layout.group.gap` | 16px | Distance between related controls in a group. |
| `layout.control.gap` | 8px | Distance between a control and its own label or hint. |
| `layout.grid.min.xs` | 12rem | The narrowest a grid column may become before the grid collapses: a stat tile. |
| `layout.grid.min.sm` | 16rem | A card. |
| `layout.grid.min.md` | 20rem | A form group. |
| `layout.grid.min.lg` | 24rem | A panel. |

## Type

Each font family token puts its first family behind an overridable slot, `--type-fontFace-<name>`, and the source value below is what fills it by default. A product that loads its own face points the slot at it (`--type-fontFace-sans: var(--font-inter)`) and never restates the stack, so the fallbacks live once, in `src/primitive/type.tokens.json`.

| Token | Value |
|---|---|
| `type.fontFamily.sans` | Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif |
| `type.fontFamily.mono` | JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace |
| `type.fontSize.xs` | 12px |
| `type.fontSize.sm` | 14px |
| `type.fontSize.base` | 16px |
